meta.title: Limits of the Barnette proof
meta.subtitle: T2 proofs unreviewed; T4 computational evidence

nodes.title: Recovery image
nodes.statement: Fixed-root recovery is injective; its image consists exactly of cycles whose inverse state is a tree matching.

nodes.title: Surface obstruction
nodes.statement: Original state parts differ by 2g on an orientable genus-g surface. Two induced trees are impossible on the torus.

nodes.title: Exponential rarity
nodes.statement: White-face prism sums have 3^q states and 2^q tree matchings.

nodes.title: Small exhaustive census
nodes.statement: 55 graphs, 1206 rooted choices, 3618 prescriptions; all tested separator and recovery conditions pass.

nodes.title: Strengthenings tested
nodes.statement: All 55 graphs pass P4, arbitrary include/avoid pairs, and opposite-color Hamiltonian paths.

nodes.title: Surjectivity fails
nodes.statement: Hexagonal prism has four avoiding cycles but only two recovered ones.
nodes.lesson: State recovery gives a subset of avoiding cycles.

nodes.title: P5 fails
nodes.statement: A four-edge cube path blocks the second incident cycle edge of vertex 5.
nodes.lesson: P4 cannot be strengthened to arbitrary longer paths.

nodes.title: Beyond the finite tests
nodes.statement: Settle arbitrary edge-pair and Hamilton-laceability literature status and larger cases.
nodes.next: Read the original strengthening literature and extend generation.

nodes.title: Mixed signs
nodes.statement: Find a smallest example with nonzero cycle gaps whose leading terms cancel.
